incident.summary: 首轮 rsync 误把当前发布目录当成目标：新目录名当时是 current 的符号链接，app/dist 被清理，官网短暂 404
incident.impact: https://bank.waveflow.men/ 与 /login 在 01:0x-01:1x（北京时间）返回 404；API 进程未受影响，登录态与数据未变
incident.recovery: 本地按生产参数重建 app/dist 并回传，官网恢复 200；随后删除误建符号链接、把发布目录移正并切换 current，重启四个服务
incident.followUp: 后续部署先确认 releases/<新目录> 是真实目录再 rsync；对 app/dist 使用单独拷贝而不是 --delete 同步

rollback: ln -sfn /srv/maneki-bank/releases/20261101-idempotency /srv/maneki-bank/current then restart the four luckycat services; no database rollback is required
limits: the demo library keeps full names in the user JSON because transfer receipts and statements still need the real name; only the clients stop rendering it
